_doc: Strategic partners powered by SOMIN. Each runs SOMIN's platform for its own clients (their cloud.<domain> deployments report into the somin.ai GA4 property) or builds on SOMIN's team and research. 'short' is the 2-5 word tagline on the Vision card; 'description' is the Vision-page card, home-plate tooltip and schema text. Write descriptions from the partner's own website only. Logos: 'logo' (for light backgrounds, Vision cards) and 'logo_dark' (on-dark variant, home plate) are trimmed transparent WebP in static/assets/img/partners/ rendered with the brand's own fonts; 'logo_w'/'logo_h' are the light file's pixel size (the dark file has the same aspect ratio); 'strip_h' is the logo's display height in px on the home plate (set per logo so they read at the same optical size; Vision cards use 1.5x, capped at 190px wide). Rendered by <!--mm:partners--> (Vision page, #partners) and <!--mm:partners compact="1"--> (home hero plate).
